periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique downward orientation relative to the horizontal facial axis, forming an approximate 45 to 60-degree angle toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a vertical-diagonal axis significantly longer than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the patch center is shifted superiorly relative to its lowest teardrop-shaped point.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad and shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior margin of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent thickness across the torso, occupying approximately one-third of the visible lateral flank height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The horizontal gap between the ear regions is approximately 1.5 to 2 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex curvature on the superior boundary of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brown-toned staining or mud accumulation is visible across the dorsal and posterior white fur regions.
